notes: All prompts are read/generate-only. Nothing writes to a live Figma file or a real project. The JSON fixtures are inline to keep evals self-contained. Graders check reasoning and output structure, not live Figma API access.

evals.name: url-required-when-no-json
evals.expected_output: Asks the user to provide a Figma project URL before doing anything else, because no URL and no JSON files were supplied.
assertions: Asks for a Figma URL (or link) before proceeding
Does not generate any output files or CSS variables without input
Does not call mcp__Figma__get_variable_defs without a URL

evals.name: json-fallback-no-url-needed
evals.prompt:
Convert these tokens to a theme.

colors.json:
```json
{"blue":{"value":"#382279","type":"color"},"white":{"value":"#ffffff","type":"color"}}
```
evals.expected_output: Processes the uploaded JSON without asking for a Figma URL. Generates theme.css with --color-blue and --color-white CSS variables, utilities.css with .text-blue, .bg-blue, .text-white, .bg-white classes, and four Blade component files. Shows the file list and waits for approval before writing.
assertions: Does NOT ask for a Figma URL when JSON files are provided
Generates --color-blue: #382279 and --color-white: #ffffff CSS variables
Generates .text-blue and .bg-blue utility classes referencing var(--color-blue)
Lists the planned output files and waits for user approval before writing
Generates separate Blade component files (button, badge, heading, text) not a single ui-kit.blade.php

evals.name: approval-gate
evals.prompt:
/theme-scaffold https://figma.com/design/ABC123/MyProject?node-id=1-2

Here are the tokens from the file:

colors.json:
```json
{"brand":{"value":"#6200EE","type":"color"}}
```
evals.expected_output: After reading the tokens, shows a list of files that will be written and waits for explicit user confirmation before generating anything.
assertions: Lists the planned output files (theme.css, utilities.css, and blade component files) before writing
Explicitly waits for user approval / confirmation before generating the files
Does not write any file before approval is given

evals.name: typography-hierarchy-exact-algorithm
evals.expected_output: Converts sizes to rem (sm=0.875rem, base=1rem, 2xl=1.5rem, 5xl=3rem). Sorts descending: 5xl, 2xl, base, sm. Maps h1→5xl, h2→2xl, h3→base, h4→sm, h5→sm (reused), h6→sm (reused). Maps body→base (closest to 1rem), small→sm (one step below base), xs→sm (smallest).
assertions: Converts 14px→0.875rem, 16px→1rem, 24px→1.5rem, 48px→3rem
Maps --h1 to var(--font-size-5xl) (largest)
Maps --h2 to var(--font-size-2xl)
Maps --h4 through --h6 to var(--font-size-sm) (reused — only 4 sizes available)
Maps --body to var(--font-size-base) (closest to 1rem)
Maps --small and --xs to var(--font-size-sm) (smallest available)

evals.name: separate-blade-component-files
evals.prompt:
Generate a Blade UI kit from these tokens.

colors.json:
```json
{"primary":{"value":"#382279","type":"color"},"white":{"value":"#ffffff","type":"color"}}
```
evals.expected_output: Generates four separate Blade files — resources/views/components/button.blade.php, badge.blade.php, heading.blade.php, text.blade.php — each with a single @props declaration. Does not generate a single ui-kit.blade.php containing multiple @props blocks.
assertions: Generates resources/views/components/button.blade.php as a separate file
Generates resources/views/components/badge.blade.php as a separate file
Generates resources/views/components/heading.blade.php as a separate file
Generates resources/views/components/text.blade.php as a separate file
Each file contains exactly one @props declaration
Does not generate a single combined ui-kit.blade.php with multiple @props blocks
